Messages.Author: Julien Moisy
Messages.Body: Can I pay more than one pool in order to gain many master during my master phase.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Julien Moisy wrote:
>
> Can I pay more than one pool in order to gain many master during my master phase.

No.
"During X, Do Y" allows only 1 Y each X.

Messages.Author: Andreas Nusser
Messages.Body:


No! It is not the same. If someone is attempting, he may not block at
all, while a blocking minion refers to an actual block.
